author: dedenholm
name: modulePseudoTether
description: modulePseudoTether.lua adds a watched-folder / pseudo-tethering module that auto-imports new files as they appear in a folder.
description-extensive: Turns a folder on your computer into a "watched" folder so photos are pulled into darktable automatically the moment they land there. This gives you a tethered-shooting-like experience without a direct camera connection: point it at the folder your camera or card reader drops files into, and new JPEG, NEF, CR2, DNG, TIFF (or a custom file type) images are imported as they arrive. You can optionally have imported files moved into an organized, dated "capture session" folder with an automatic session counter. Note: the folder-watching relies on Linux's file-change notification system, so this is aimed at Linux users, and the code has the feel of a rough, in-progress project.
